disposition_audit.rationale: Retained as the sole canonical desired-state/schedule reconciler. Locked default dev mode to reconcile_only with zero provider egress. Added run_controller_once() for bounded manual execution.
Legacy HTTP worker utility. Audited and retained only as an internal library helper; never restored as a background daemon.
Consolidated onto controller_worker.py:run_controller_once(). Supports explicit connector selection, one-tick execution, terminal readback, and immediate process exit.

Dev default posture locked to reconcile_only with MAX_TICKS=0, zero provider selection, and unless-stopped restart, matching non-prod deployment and ensuring default compose startup produces zero provider egress without configuration errors.
